channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Caputo meets Bessent and Georgieva at G20 finance summit
item.description: Argentina's Economy Minister Luis Caputo held three bilateral meetings at the G20 summit in North Carolina, winning praise from the IMF and U.S. Treasury.

item.title: House passes stopgap funding bill through December, averting shutdown
item.description: A bipartisan stopgap keeps the lights on through December, but the fine print reveals the familiar fault lines of American fiscal governance.

item.title: Inter Miami CF II beats NYCFC II 4-2 in MLS Next Pro
item.description: Inter Miami CF II scored three first-half goals and held on despite a red card to beat NYCFC II 4-2 Tuesday night in Fort Lauderdale.

item.title: Massachusetts Democrats re-nominate Markey, Clark, Neal, and Lynch
item.description: Senator Ed Markey, Representative Katherine Clark, Representative Richard Neal, and Representative Stephen Lynch each secured Democratic nominations in Massachusetts primary contests Tuesday.

item.title: Smithsonian selects Arts and Industries Building for Latino museum
item.description: The Smithsonian Board of Regents chose a historic Victorian landmark on the National Mall as the forever home of the long-awaited Latino museum.

item.title: Petrobras raises jet fuel prices and wins Wall Street upgrades
item.description: Petrobras hiked jet fuel prices 13.9% in early September, capping a 53.3% rise in 2026, as Wall Street upgrades follow record quarterly profits.

item.title: Argentina wins men's bronze at 2026 Hockey World Cup
item.description: Argentina beat the Netherlands 2-1 in Amsterdam to secure men's hockey bronze at the 2026 FIH World Cup on August 30.

item.title: Sheinbaum delivers second annual address highlighting Pemex, fiscal gains
item.description: President Sheinbaum's second annual address spotlighted a $20 billion Pemex debt cut, rising foreign investment, and a trillion-peso welfare commitment.

item.title: Apple Maps adopts 'Lake America' for US users after Trump order
item.description: Apple Maps and Google Maps have adopted 'Lake America' for U.S. users following President Trump's executive order renaming Lake Ontario.

item.title: Minogue wins GOP primary, will face Healey in November
item.description: Michael Minogue defeated Brian Shortsleeve in Tuesday's Republican primary and will meet incumbent Democratic Gov. Maura Healey on November 3.

item.title: Markey wins Massachusetts Senate Democratic primary over Moulton
item.description: Sen. Ed Markey defeated Rep. Seth Moulton by nearly 30 points in the Massachusetts Democratic Senate primary on September 1, 2026.

item.title: Tyler Robinson ordered to trial in Charlie Kirk murder case
item.description: A Utah judge found probable cause Tuesday to send Tyler James Robinson, 23, to trial on an aggravated murder charge carrying the death penalty.

item.title: U.S. and Venezuela sign oil deal giving Pentagon stake in reserves
item.description: Trump announced the agreement on Truth Social, calling it the largest oil deal in world history and projecting lower gas prices for Americans.

item.title: NY Latino Film Festival opens with Tyler Perry-backed 'Otra'
item.description: As NYLFF turns 26, its opening-night choice reveals how Latino cinema is quietly renegotiating the terms of mainstream visibility.

item.title: Iran attempts cyberattacks on U.S. infrastructure as markets drift
item.description: Iran's infrastructure cyberattacks failed so far, but they signal a durable pattern of digital conflict that markets and policymakers can't afford to ignore.

item.title: Messi retires from international football after 2026 World Cup final loss
item.description: Lionel Messi's retirement from Argentina duty closes a 21-year arc that reshaped what a footballer's relationship with an entire nation can mean.

item.title: Pembroke Pines ranked no. 1 U.S. city for Hispanic entrepreneurs in 2026
item.description: WalletHub's 2026 report ranks Pembroke Pines first among more than 180 U.S. cities, citing the highest Hispanic entrepreneurship rate in the country.

item.title: Messi wins 15th MLS Player of the Matchday honor after four-goal game
item.description: The Argentine forward's four-goal, one-assist night powered Inter Miami to a 7-1 rout and pushed his career award total to 15.

item.title: GALIFF XV to honor Roberto Sanchez at Fox Theatre in October
item.description: The Southeast's only Latino film festival brings a quinceañera spirit to the Fox Theatre this fall, honoring a Cuban-American screen veteran with more than 150 credits.

item.title: Woman fatally stabbed in Times Square; attacker shot dead by police
item.description: NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch described the Monday afternoon attack as random and unprovoked; Mayor Zohran Mamdani has ordered an internal investigation.

item.title: Messi retires from Argentina national team after 2026 World Cup final loss
item.description: Messi, 39, closes 21 years of international duty with 207 caps and 125 goals after a 1-0 extra-time World Cup final defeat to Spain.

item.title: SSCP's Texas Applebee's offer two $6.99 margaritas for Hispanic Heritage Month
item.description: The Dallas-based SSCP Management is kicking off Hispanic Heritage Month early with two $6.99 margaritas at its Texas Applebee's locations.

item.title: USMCA uncertainty stalls new foreign investment in Mexico
item.description: New foreign investment in Mexico dropped 13% in early 2026 as USMCA uncertainty and a judicial overhaul push companies toward Asia.

item.title: Mexico remittances rise 3% in July for sixth straight month
item.description: Banxico data show six straight months of gains, but a stronger peso cut July's real value by 6.5%, squeezing household budgets.
